title: Unified Sulfur
description: Adds compatability for BetterEnd, Spelunkery and Alex Caves for recipes
body:
Sulfur Compat
A simple datapack that unifies sulfur items from Spelunkery, Alex's Caves, BetterEnd, and Burnt under the forge:dusts/sulfur tag, allowing all four to be used interchangeably in each other's recipes.
Compatible mods:

Spelunkery
Alex's Caves
BetterEnd
Burnt

Installation: Drop into your world's datapacks/ folder, or use Global Packs for a global install. Run /reload in-game.

License: No license — do whatever you want with it.
This datapack was created with AI assistance. I don't know Java or Minecraft modding — this was entirely figured out through trial and error with Claude.
